rules.statement: An act is considered dishonest and fraudulent when it involves an intention to cause wrongful gain to one person or wrongful loss to another, even if the means employed are lawful but the intent is not.
rules.supporting_quote: "whoever does anything with the intention of causing wrongful gain to one person or wrongful loss to another person is said to do that thing dishonestly" and "a person is said to do a thing fraudulently if he does that thing with intent to defraud but not otherwise"
